narrative:
Hedge notional is USD 58B, concentrated in the Meridian Trading book; upstream equity barrels stay unhedged because the term OSP book is the natural hedge. The cash-flow hedge reserve is USD 1.65B with 96% effectiveness under IFRS 9.

Singapore–Rotterdam crack basis created USD 41M of ineffectiveness on European-sold JV barrels; total P&L ineffectiveness is −USD 85M, driven by basis mismatch and cancelled turnaround cargoes.

signals.title: Trading-book hedge program
signals.excerpt: Hedge notional $58B, 96% effective under IFRS 9; cash-flow hedge reserve $1.65B; ineffectiveness −$85M from Singapore–Rotterdam crack basis.

signals.title: Refining margin squeeze at international JVs
signals.excerpt: International Refining JVs run at 68% cost of sales; a $2/bbl drop in the Singapore complex margin costs about $2B of EBITDA.
